note: 화풍 부품 — 축마다 부품, 부품마다 판(v). 화풍 문단 = direction + face + paint(이 차례로 한 문단), 빛 줄 = 'Light: ' + light + fx. 부품을 고치면 그 부품 versions 에 새 판을 더하고 current 를 올린다 — 옛 판은 지우지 않는다(옛 그림 기록이 그 판을 가리킨다). code 는 조합 이름에 들어가는 짧은 코드(축 안에서 겹치지 않게). only = 이 부품과 같이 쓸 수 있는 다른 축 부품(없으면 아무거나). avoid = 5칸 제약에 합쳐지는 피할 것(영어, 마침표 없이). models.<모델> · worlds.<세계> = 그 모델 · 세계에서만 바꿔 쓰는 글. 처음 판은 삼국지 공방 data/style.json 의 새로 쓴 화풍 열(2026-11-10)을 축별로 쪼갠 것.

Painted with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges and a few crisp accents on the face and costume, with thin coloured linework.

Delicate oil brushwork and layered glazes of colour, soft edges, refined detail kept for the face and costume, and silk and metal each with their own painterly texture.
Bold brushwork: thick confident strokes, forms built from large shapes of colour, and detail spent only on the face and a few focal ornaments.
Crisp thin dark linework, hair drawn as many fine strands with light along every lock, and soft airy cel-to-gradient shading; the face and body stay visibly illustrated in 2D, never a 3D render.
Soft matte painting: smooth soft shading with gentle gradients and quiet, powdery surfaces.
Smooth appealing forms, soft subsurface skin and simplified, readable materials rather than photoreal detail.

Photorealistic surface rendering: lifelike translucent skin with subtle subsurface scattering, delicate microtexture and small localised specular highlights; individually resolved fine hair strands; silk, lacquer, leather, metal and gems each with physically convincing roughness and reflections. No outlines, cel shading or broad brushwork; no waxy or uniformly glossy skin.
